raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that Maria Luisa of Savoy’s father-in-law was Louis XIV of France by assuming Philip V was Louis XIV’s son. In reality, Philip V’s father was Louis, Grand Dauphin (making him Maria Luisa’s father-in-law and Louis XIV her grandfather-in-law). This misidentification occurred before verification and was repeated despite sources indicating Philip was “the second son of Louis, Grand Dauphin.”
